4. 23­51404 Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on the Equity and
  Human Relations Commission’s November 13, 2023 letter to the Mayor
  and City Council.
  A motion was made by Commissioner Montgomery, seconded by Vice Chair
  Covington, to approve recommendation. No vote was taken on the motion.
  A motion was made by Chair Lara, seconded by Vice Chair Covington, to [1]
  request Office of Equity staff to write a letter from the Equity and Human
  Relations Commission to Mayor and City Council, including the following
  elements: [a] Acknowledge the humanitarian crisis in Gaza; [b] Adopt a local
  resolution in support of a lasting ceasefire; [c] Identify community education
  and supportive resources aligned with this topic; and [d] Continue to
  acknowledge and condemn anti­Semitism, anti­Arab, and anti­Palestinian
  sentiments, and Islamophobia; [2] present the letter to the Equity and Human
  Relations Commission at a Special Meeting to vote on sending the letter to the
  Mayor and City Council; and [3] request Mayor and City Council to work with
  the Office of Equity to identify local organizations that center Arab, Jewish,
  Palestinian and Muslim experiences and voices to provide input in developing
  the local ceasefire statement.. The motion carried by the following vote:
  Yes:  9 Batts, Gutierrez, Schultz, Covington, Butler, Lissette Flores, Gillette,
  Lara, Montgomery
